name: IFA Retail (Grupo IFA)
desc: Madrid-based purchasing and services alliance of independent Spanish and European supermarket groups such as Ahorramas, Alimerka, Bon Preu and Dinosol.
products: central purchasing, own-label and services for member supermarket chains
customers: member supermarket and hypermarket groups (25 associates shown, incl. Ahorramas, Alimerka, Bon Preu, Dinosol, Unide, Bolaños, Sonae MC)
stores_or_sites: members operate 6,400+ stores in Spain and 11,200+ in Europe (members' stores, not IFA's)
markets: Spain mainly, with member chains across Europe (countries not listed on the page)

fin.value_orig: EUR 1,191.5m sales 2024 (IFA Retail SA, filed accounts)

profitability_basis: elEconomista shows a EUR 3.8m result for 2025
fit_rationale: A B2B purchasing alliance with no consumer brand; the EUR 1.2bn is pass-through buying for member chains. Hospitality for supplier and member executives is the only plausible use. Low fit.
outstanding: ownership (members' shares?), whether IFA's revenue is a commission or gross purchasing; group gross billing EUR 45.6bn is members' sales, not IFA revenue

name: SELAE Loterías y Apuestas del Estado

products: Lotería Nacional, El Gordo, Euromillones, La Primitiva, La Quiniela

compliance: Spanish gambling advertising rules (Real Decreto 958/2020) apply; state lotteries partly exempt - to verify
